citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The following IACUC deficiencies were noted at time of inspection:
-The facility conducted program and facility reviews on August 15, 2025, and April 18, 2026. The duration between the
reviews was greater than six months.
- The facility did not prepare reports of its reviews, signed by a majority of the IACUC members, and submit them to the
IO for either the August 15, 2025 or April 18, 2026 reviews.
Program and facility reviews are required every six months to ensure adequate and timely IACUC oversight, and to
ensure the welfare of the animals being used in research by the facility. Failure to submit reports of the findings to the IO
at least once every six months may hinder the IO's awareness of challenges and departures relating to the care and use
of animals and potentially delaying corrective actions. A system should be in place to ensure program and facility reviews
are completed at least once every 6 months, signed by the majority of the IACUC, and submitted to the Institutional
Officer.
To be corrected from this day forward, July 22, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
